info.title: Local Chatbot API
info.description: Stable v1 baseline for existing unversioned UI/admin routes. See README.md beside this document for authentication, compatibility and versioning rules. Demo STT/TTS servers and browser assets are excluded.

x-compatibility.legacy_routes: All existing unversioned paths remain v1 throughout 1.x releases.
x-compatibility.breaking_changes: Require a new major, parallel versioned routes, migration guide and at least 180 days announced deprecation before removing v1.
x-compatibility.response_extensions: Clients must ignore unknown response properties; checked-in schemas must document all emitted properties.
x-compatibility.request_extensions: Unknown JSON fields are rejected; clients must send only documented fields.

post.summary: Validate a json import and preview duplicates, samples, chunks and processing work without publication.
post.description: No job, payload retention, embedding or knowledge write. Reads existing hashes. Content problems return 200 with valid=false and actionable issues; a structurally valid duplicate PDF has valid=true and can_publish=false unless replacement is enabled. Transport/schema/auth/size failures use standard errors. This advisory snapshot is revalidated on publication. Shares upload admission limits.

AdminSession.name: __Host-local_chatbot_admin
AdminSession.description: Secure host-only HttpOnly admin cookie. Development uses local_chatbot_admin_dev. No bearer/API-key authentication is supported. All mutations additionally require CSRF proof, including login.

ChatSession.name: __Host-local_chatbot_chat
ChatSession.description: Server-issued anonymous ownership cookie; development uses local_chatbot_chat_dev. Required to rate an owned message, not to ask a question.

Error.description: Normalized JSON error; includes X-Error-Code and Cache-Control: no-store. Authentication, origin, CSRF and admission checks can precede payload validation.

user_id.description: Accepted for legacy callers; ignored for identity and ownership.

anyOf.description: Legacy Flask HTTP-date (RFC 1123), not an ISO timestamp.
